title: Govt Retains 4% Retail Inflation Target for 2026-2031 Cycle
summary: Department of Economic Affairs retains 4% headline CPI (consumer price index tracking retail inflation) target with +/-2% tolerance band (2-6% range) under Sec 45-ZA of RBI Act.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Govt Retains 4% Retail Inflation Target for 2026-2031 Cycle. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Government retained the **4% headline CPI (consumer price index tracking retail inflation) inflation target (±2% tolerance band)** for the 5-year period April 2026 – March 2031 under Section 45-ZA of the RBI Act, 1934.
